//: Root SHARED BASE. Preflight's canonical execution model is Node native TypeScript
type-stripping (Node >=23.6): every package runs and TESTS directly from .ts source with
zero installs (see each package.json). `tsc` is used only to (a) emit @preflight/core to
dist/ for external consumers and (b) typecheck the eval harness — never to run the code.
Builds are per-package via `npm run build`; each package owns its own tsconfig.json with
the concrete outDir/noEmit. This base only records the settings they share. Contracts is
pure .mjs (no TypeScript) and has no tsconfig.
